title: Rare 2,000-year-old perfume bottle and ancient treasures found in Italy's Pompeii
description: Archaeologists have discovered a rare perfume bottle, children's necklaces, coins, and other ancient objects inside a cupboard in the ruins of the historic Italian city of Pompeii, 2424NewsHD TV reported on Monday.

title: 15 Things Older Americans Still Use Every Day That Gen Z Thinks Are Ancient
description: From paper checkbooks to landlines, these 15 things older Americans still use every day look like museum pieces to Gen Z. The post 15 Things Older Americans Still Use Every Day That Gen Z Thinks Are Ancient appeared first on Wealth Gang .

title: Archaeologists Pulled Massive 80-Ton Stones From the Sea That Once Belonged to One of the Ancient World's Seven Wonders
description: Hidden beneath the sea for centuries, giant stone blocks are revealing astonishing clues about an ancient marvel.

title: This Military Mistake Nearly Cost Ancient Athens Everything
description: In the fifth century B.C., Athens set out to take the Sicilian city of Syracuse. A grave miscalculation and a traitor’s betrayal would start the empire’s downfall.

title: Work to save the Afghan capital’s crumbling ancient fortress uncovers archaeological treasures
description: KABUL, Afghanistan (AP) — Perched high above the southern edge of Kabul’s old city, the imposing fortress of Bala Hissar has endured centuries of invasions, uprisings and conflict that scarred Afghanistan and left the citadel crumbling. Now, an extensive, yearslong project by the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, or AKTC, is painstakingly conserving Bala Hissar....
